subject.title: fix(codex): prefer the pinned runtime for current models

question: Is the focused Testbox coverage sufficient to land this protected executable-owner change without a live affected-model macOS run?
rationale: The implementation appears correct, but it changes compatibility-sensitive runtime and auth/model routing for existing desktop installations, and tests cannot demonstrate the contributor's real affected setup.

options.title: Require live macOS proof
options.body: Request redacted terminal evidence showing an ordinary affected-model turn selects the pinned runtime and Computer Use remains desktop-owned on a machine with the older desktop bundle installed.

options.title: Accept automated proof
options.body: Land based on the focused Testbox suites while explicitly accepting the documented process-local fence and Gateway-restart limitation.

recommendation.title: Require live macOS proof
recommendation.body: Request redacted terminal evidence showing an ordinary affected-model turn selects the pinned runtime and Computer Use remains desktop-owned on a machine with the older desktop bundle installed.

likelyOwner.reason: He is assigned to this PR and has the strongest merged history across the affected Codex app-server lifecycle and runtime-selection modules.
